subject: Aligning senior technical window to move pilot forward
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@retailforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: propose senior technical window to unblock pilot

Hi Liam —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the candid run-through of RetailForge's ingestion volumes and the latency targets you need for catalog search augmentation. Quick recap and proposed next step:

- Recap: primary use case is near-real-time embedding lookups for search re-ranking across ~10M SKUs, 99th pct latency target ~120ms for reads, and retention constraints for logs for 90 days.
- Asks we noted: SOC2 evidence, network architecture for VPC peering, and a quick cost sensitivity analysis for moving from hosted -> dedicated pools.

To keep momentum, the ask from your CT0/VP of Eng is to do a short exec-level alignment (VP/CTO handshake) plus a 45–60m technical deep dive with our infra lead. That call will unblock a scoped pilot and allow us to produce a pilot POC plan and pricing estimate.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu 24 Jul, 09:30–10:30
- Thu 24 Jul, 13:00–14:00
- Mon 28 Jul, 11:00–12:00

If those don't fit, tell me a couple of windows and we'll accommodate. I've attached the discovery notes and our one-pager for the senior call so your CTO has a short brief.

Agenda (high level):
1) 10m — brief exec alignment (objectives & success criteria)
2) 30–40m — technical deep dive (data paths, latency targets, infra options)
3) 10m — pilot gating and next steps (timeline + decision points)

Who from your side do you expect on the call? If your CTO prefers, we can keep the exec portion to 15 minutes and expand the technical session.

Thanks — will lock a slot once you confirm availability.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: discovery-notes-RetailForge-20250722.pdf, redwood-onepager-2025.pdf
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@retailforge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Martinez <ava.martinez@retailforge.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: propose senior technical window to unblock pilot

Karthik —

Thanks for the recap and the attachments — helpful. Quick notes: our CTO (Priya Singh) is traveling and out of pocket Thu morning, but VP Eng (Ava Martinez) can join either Thu 24 Jul at 13:00 PDT or Mon 28 Jul at 11:00 PDT. Thu 09:30 won't work for the executive portion.

For the technical deep dive, our platform lead (me) and one of our infra architects (Ravi Patel) should join. Can you include whoever owns runtime/quantization decisions on your side?

Also, for the exec portion, can you include a one-slide summary of pilot success criteria (metrics + decision gate) so our leadership can review ahead of the call?

Either Thu 24 @13:00 PDT or Mon 28 @11:00 PDT works — Thu is slightly preferred.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering, RetailForge
liam.oconnor@retailforge.com | +1 (617) 555-2288
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@retailforge.com>, Ava Martinez <ava.martinez@retailforge.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: propose senior technical window to unblock pilot

Looping in a couple quick coordination notes — including here so the external thread has visibility.

Karthik / Neha:
- Karthik: please own the exec 10–15m (success criteria slide) and the pilot decision gates slide. I can field the commercial timeline and high-level SOW approach.
- Neha: can you prepare to lead the infra/runway section on the deep dive (KV-cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs, and expected token throughput estimates)? We should plan to show a short perf slide with target latency bands so Ravi can react.

Liam / Ava: we'll keep the exec piece tight and then move into the deeper technical session — happy to adapt the agenda as you prefer.

Karthik — please send a short slide (one page) with success criteria and the calendar invite once Liam confirms Thu @13:00 PDT. Also include a short link to the SOC2 evidence package in the invite notes.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-3410

Thanks — Thu 24 Jul at 13:00 PDT is locked. Calendar invite + agendas are linked here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-vpctointro-20250724

Quick checklist so we show up ready:
- RetailForge: VP Eng Ava, Platform lead Liam, infra architect Ravi (confirmed)
- Redwood: Marissa (exec), Neha (infra lead), Karthik (AE / success criteria & SOW sketch)
- I attached a one-slide success criteria doc to the invite and added a link to our SOC2 evidence bucket in the event body.

We'll aim for a tight 15m exec alignment then a 45m technical run-through. If anything changes on your side, reply and I can update the invite.

Looking forward — see you Thursday.

Best,
